notes: Cover-only research pass, 2026-09-16, for 28 published universities across NZ, North Macedonia, Norway, Philippines, Portugal, Serbia, Sweden, Switzerland, Trinidad and Tobago, Uganda, UAE, UK, USA, Vietnam plus eight never-researched records (Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bulgaria, China, Guyana x2, Jamaica, Malawi). Method: (1) grepped the July 2026 a-*.json batches and second-pass-patches/*.json for every slug first, so no dead end was repeated; (2) Wikipedia pageimages API for the lead image of the en/az/ru/mk/sr/bg/vi/zh/no/pt article; (3) Wikimedia Commons list=search and generator=categorymembers with prop=imageinfo&iiprop=url|size|mime|extmetadata, run in English and in the local language/script where relevant (Македонски, Български, Српски, Azərbaycanca, Русский, 中文, Tiếng Việt, Norsk, Portugues); (4) official institutional domains via curl for og:image and hero/campus-page imagery where Commons had nothing. Every sourceUrl in this file was verified in-session with curl -sIL and returned HTTP 200 with an image/* content-type; query strings were stripped from upload.wikimedia.org URLs. Ambiguous or under-documented candidates (Khalifa, Azerbaijan Medical University, Belarusian State Medical University, Caltech, the Skopje deanery, the KUHES and Texila candidates) were downloaded and visually inspected before acceptance or rejection. SYSTEMIC FINDING: the July 2026 pass researched covers almost exclusively by scraping institutional homepages and never queried Wikimedia Commons; that is why large, well-documented public universities (Caltech, UMass Amherst, Delaware, Geneva, Chalmers, Victoria Wellington, AUT, UWI St. Augustine, Gulf Medical, Huddersfield) were held. All of those are resolved here from free-licence Commons files. Wikimedia returned HTTP 429 mid-verification; affected URLs were re-verified with backoff and all returned 200. CAVEATS recorded per entry below: Goce Delcev uses the parent university's main building (no faculty-specific photo exists); Mbarara uses the MUST Kihumuro campus (university-level, not faculty-level); Van Lang's file is 960px wide, slightly under the 1000px preference, but is the only free genuine VLU campus photograph and VLU's own og:image still returns HTTP 403 as it did in July.

entries.universityName: Catolica Medical School, Universidade Catolica Portuguesa
entries.reason: No verifiable image of the Sintra medical school building found. Commons: searched 'Universidade Catolica Portuguesa Sintra', 'Catolica Medical School', 'Faculdade de Medicina Universidade Catolica' in English and Portuguese - Category:Universidade Catolica Portuguesa and the pt.wikipedia lead image return only File:CATOLICA Logotipo.png (a logo, excluded). No photograph of any UCP campus, Sintra or Lisbon, exists on Commons. Official domains: the faculty's own site fm.ucp.pt returns a 20-byte body to curl on both /sintra-campus-building and /sintra-campus (HTTP 200 but JS-rendered/bot-gated, no og:image, no , no background-image in the delivered HTML), so the Sintra building photo published there could not be resolved to a direct image URL and I will not guess one. www.ucp.pt declares an og:image of logo-mobile@2x.png (a logo) and its only other same-domain images are EU/PRR/Republica Portuguesa funding badges; www.ucp.pt/medicalschool returns 404. lisboa.ucp.pt/explorecampi-lisboasintra-campus/presentation returns HTTP 200 but its only file-system images are the same funding badges plus CATOLICA-LISBOA.png (a logo). Deliberately did not substitute the Lisbon main campus for the Sintra medical school per the identity requirement. Retry route: fetch fm.ucp.pt/sintra-campus-building with a JS-capable renderer.
entries.reason_note: Sintra building: designed by Bartolomeu da Costa Cabral, inaugurated 2001, rehabilitated 2021 for the Faculty of Medicine - identified via search but no retrievable image file.

entries.universityName: University of Kragujevac Faculty of Medical Sciences
entries.reason: No correctly-identified faculty image found. Commons/Wikipedia: the en.wikipedia lead image for University of Kragujevac is File:UBKG10.jpg, but its Commons description and categories confirm it depicts the University Library in Kragujevac (Category:University Library Kragujevac), not the Faculty of Medical Sciences - rejected as the wrong subject. Searched Commons for 'Medicinski fakultet Kragujevac', 'Крагујевац медицински факултет', 'University of Kragujevac Faculty of Medical Sciences' in Latin and Cyrillic: zero file results; sr.wikipedia 'Медицински факултет у Крагујевцу' returns NO IMAGE. Official domain medf.kg.ac.rs: re-fetched the homepage, /index.php and /en/ (all HTTP 200); /o-nama.php is 404. Every image served is either a logo (logo_mf.png, logos.png, unkgfmn2026.png, erasmus-logo.png) or a dated news/event thumbnail (GRAS2026.jpg, the_third_annual_enrollment.jpg, vel/BMCR_2026.jpg, vel/Hubei_2026.jpg) - no building or campus photography anywhere on the site. Consistent with the July 2026 finding (a-421-435.json) that the only non-logo homepage image was a video poster frame.
entries.reason_note: Do not substitute File:UBKG10.jpg - it is the university library, a different institution unit.

entries.reason: Held deliberately, per the instruction to be strict with this small private provider rather than accept a generic Georgetown photo. Commons: searched 'Texila American University', 'Texila American University Guyana campus' - the only file is File:Texila American University Logo.jpg (448x302), a logo, which is also the en.wikipedia lead image; no photographic file exists. Official domains: www.texilaamericanuniversity.com does not respond to curl (connection failure, exit code 000, on both / and /campus/). The Guyana site tau.edu.gy does respond (HTTP 200 on /, /about-us/, /campus-life/, /guyana-campus/) but its only photographic assets are campus-gallery-1..6.jpg; I fetched the originals directly from tau.edu.gy/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/ and all are 800x600 - under the 1000 px bar - and visual inspection of campus-gallery-1.jpg shows an interior corridor/atrium with students standing at a railing, i.e. a people-focused interior snapshot, not a campus or building cover image. Every other image on those pages is a logo, an accreditation badge (ACCM, CAAM-HP, ECFMG, WDOMS, BAC) or a DMCA badge. No stock or aggregator image was considered.

entries.reason: No verifiable campus or building photograph found. Commons: searched 'Kamuzu University of Health Sciences', 'Kamuzu University of Health Sciences Blantyre', 'College of Medicine Blantyre Malawi' - zero relevant image files; the only hits were unrelated PDFs and 19th-century Nyasaland/Livingstone photographs. Official domain kuhes.ac.mw (HTTP 200): the homepage carries four slider banners, of which I downloaded and visually inspected KUHES-Banner-3748x980.jpg - it is a flat-orange marketing graphic with the slogan 'THE FUTURE IS BETTER TOGETHER' and a cut-out group of students/clinicians, i.e. a people-and-slogan composite, not a campus photograph; Excellence-For-Life-3-3748x980.jpg is the same 3748x980 banner format from the same campaign series.
